title: Iberian Peninsula: Spain and Portugal
brief_description: A brief survey of modern Spain and Portugal showing the chief topographic and climatic features of th Peninsula, and portraying people at work in various types of agricultural pursuits and in fishing, mining and industry. Emphasises especially the Peninsula’s limited industrialisation and the age-old agricultural techniques generally employed in the region.
